maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from nursing, assisted living, hospice and home care services, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Skilled nursing centers are mostly paid by Medicare and Medicaid, the largest payers for its patients.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by operating and expanding its own nursing centers, senior living and home care; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Residents in skilled nursing, memory care and psychiatric hospitals face disruption and risk moving; regulated care.
